'''Pell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He served in the [[Republic Army]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On Coruscant he worked out of the [[Equipment Requisitions (Senate Commercial District)|Equipment Requisitions]] area of the [[Senate Commercial District]] and sold speciality goods with gear.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pell first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a vendor of speciality items. He is only accessible to Republic players in the game as he is found on Coruscant which is a Republic only planet.
